# Featured posts for the homepage "X / Twitter timeline" card.
#
# HOW IT WORKS
#   Put one X/Twitter post URL (or bare tweet ID) per line — newest or most
#   important first. Every few hours the "Update X posts" GitHub Action fetches
#   each post's LIVE content (text, photo, like count) and refreshes the card.
#   The card shows the 3 most recent of whatever is listed here.
#
# TO ADD A POST
#   Open the post on X, copy its URL, and paste it below. That's it.
#   e.g.   https://x.com/rebelsnlu_jaist/status/1846000000000000000
#
# Lines starting with # are ignored. Blank lines are fine.
#
